why: Violations of ADR-0009 that exist on the pages M1b shipped, written down so
the gate can fail on new ones from its first run rather than after the pages
are rebuilt. It can only shrink: a finding that is not here fails the build,
and an entry here that no longer matches anything also fails, with 'this is
fixed, delete the line'. Every entry is a defect, not a decision.
palette '*' means the finding is the same in day and night, which it should
be — day and night are one design in two materials (R-UI-07), so a violation
in only one of them is itself worth looking at.

accepted.note: R-UI-10. A stock ui-button is a whole row of its group and cannot be smaller than one, so it fills the surface. Closes when the page is rebuilt on the soft-key rail (ADR-0009).

accepted.key: Yes, I can still reach it
accepted.note: R-UI-10, as above. This is the confirmation for a radio-moving apply, so it is the one that most needs to be reachable rather than merely large.

The join form is 172px of content in 48px. Same class of defect as K-13 — theme.ts already unclips markdown, and a form has the same problem for the same reason: a widget takes its height from a configured row span, and a form is taller than one row.
The ping form, 112px of content in 48px. As above.
